Received Letter of Empanelment for 6,869 Off-Grid DC Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems under PM Kusum B Scheme to be executed within 1 year.
Oswal Solar Energy incorporated Oswal Doon Baran Bundi Solar Projects Limited as a 60% subsidiary for a 33 MW Rajasthan solar HAM project.

timeline.summary: Vivek Gupta, promoter, declared no new encumbrances on Oswal Pumps Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26.
Empanelled by MSEDCL for 6,896 solar pumps worth ₹162.06 Cr under PM KUSUM B Scheme.
Oswal Pumps received a Letter of Empanelment from MSEDCL for 6,869 off-grid DC solar photovoltaic water pumping systems under the PM Kusum B Scheme.
Oswal Pumps subsidiary incorporated Oswal Doon Baran Bundi Solar Projects Limited as a 60:40 JV for a 33 MW solar project in Rajasthan.
Oswal Pumps published its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY2026 showing ₹618.65 Cr utilized out of ₹890.00 Cr gross IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹509.74 Cr (+39.8% YoY), net profit ₹92.53 Cr (+44.8% YoY).
Oswal Pumps issued a press release highlighting record FY26 total income of ₹2,085.9 Cr (+45.6% YoY) and PAT of ₹376.3 Cr (+34.1% YoY).
Oswal Pumps reported record FY26 revenue of ₹2,064.4 Cr and PAT of ₹376.3 Cr, driven by strong solar pump execution.
Presented strategy presentation detailing 1,500 MW solar module expansion funded by ₹153.66 Cr IPO proceeds and rooftop solar diversification.
Oswal Pumps Limited shared the audio recording link for its May 18, 2026, Q4FY2026 conference call via **Anish Kumar** (signed by).
Oswal Pumps held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding 20-25% revenue growth and 22-23% EBITDA margin for FY27.
Oswal Pumps acquired an additional 8% stake in Walso Solar Solution Private Limited for ₹3.66 Cr on June 8, 2026, raising its holding to 51% and making it a subsidiary.
Oswal Pumps secured a repeat order worth ₹235.92 Cr from MSEDCL for 10,000 solar water pumping systems under the PM-KUSUM B scheme.
